description:
fixture_facts.rs is 458 lines with no production consumer; its only callers are lib unit tests (fixture_contract_harness_test, fixture_facts_test). No integration test uses it.

Gate it #[cfg(test)] in place. Do NOT extract it to a crate: it imports World, LoweredBody, ActivationKey, SemanticOrd and CallSiteSummary, so a separate crate would force those public and create a larger surface than the one being removed.

Consequence to handle: transport_test.rs includes fixture_facts.rs in its production_order_owners source-discipline scan. Once it is not production, that entry goes.

Done when: fixture_facts is absent from a non-test build, transport_test no longer audits it as production, and the full gate is green.
title: Gate fixture_facts behind cfg(test)
